families.name: Security
families.purpose: Defensive security planning, review and documentation of materials the user supplies.
families.flow: Clarify the asset and decision, review only supplied material, rank findings with stated uncertainty, then hand a written result to the people who own the system.
families.notes: Defensive work on supplied material only. No offensive tooling, exploitation steps, evasion or probing of systems. Findings stay provisional until the system owner verifies them. A suspected live incident goes to the user's responsible people at once.

families.name: IT operations
families.purpose: Documentation and planning for everyday IT support and infrastructure upkeep.
families.flow: Capture the environment and constraint, draft the document or plan, check it against the supplied details, then hand it to the person who will carry it out.

families.name: Software engineering
families.purpose: Planning, review and documentation of software changes from supplied code, requirements and notes.
families.flow: Pin down the requirement, plan the smallest change, review supplied code or tests, then document the result. Nothing is run or changed in the user's systems by these instructions.

families.name: AI and machine learning
families.purpose: Designing prompts, evaluations and experiments for AI and machine learning work.
families.flow: State the task and success measure, draft the prompt, evaluation or experiment plan, and mark what still needs real runs by the user.

families.name: Product and design
families.purpose: Product definition, user research planning, interface writing and design review.
families.flow: Define the user problem, plan the research or design work, produce the written or visual-brief deliverable, then review for accessibility and clarity.

families.name: Content and creative
families.purpose: Writing and planning of articles, scripts, newsletters and other creative content.
families.flow: Confirm audience and purpose, outline, draft, then edit against the brief. Facts that are not supplied are marked, not invented.

families.name: Marketing and growth
families.purpose: Campaign planning and materials for a small business, plus focused growth specialists. The four core roles are the starter pack.
families.flow: Follow the marketing campaign workflow: goal, package, visual direction if needed, create and check, deliver. Add the specialists whose deliverable the package needs.

families.name: Sales and customer
families.purpose: Drafts and plans for selling, supporting and onboarding customers.
families.flow: Confirm the customer and offer, draft the sales or support material from supplied facts, and review claims before the user uses it.

families.name: Business operations
families.purpose: Process, planning and decision documents for running a small organization.
families.flow: Name the process or decision, gather the facts supplied, produce the document, and list open assumptions for the owner.

families.name: Finance
families.purpose: Educational drafts, explanations and checks of financial figures the user supplies.
families.flow: Confirm the figures and period, show assumptions and arithmetic, produce the draft or check, and flag every number that still needs confirmation.
families.notes: Educational drafts and checks on supplied numbers. Not financial, tax, accounting or investment advice. Show assumptions and arithmetic. Decisions and filings belong to the user and a qualified professional.

families.name: Data and research
families.purpose: Planning and reviewing research, surveys and data analysis from supplied sources and data.
families.flow: State the question, plan the method, analyze or summarize only the supplied material, and report limits and what was not checked.

families.name: People and HR
families.purpose: Drafts for hiring, onboarding, reviews and workplace policies, for human decision.
families.flow: Confirm the role or policy and the organization's own rules, draft the material, check it for fairness and clarity, and leave every decision to the responsible people.
families.notes: Drafts for human decision. Avoid discriminatory criteria and do not infer protected traits. No automated hiring, discipline or termination decisions. Employment-law questions go to a qualified professional.

families.name: Legal and compliance
families.purpose: Plain-language reading, drafting and checklists from documents and rules the user supplies.
families.flow: Confirm the document, jurisdiction and purpose, work only from supplied sources, state what is uncertain, and send decisions to a qualified professional.
families.notes: Plain-language support, not legal advice. Work only from user-supplied sources. State jurisdiction and currency uncertainty. No claim of compliance, certification or enforceability. Consequential decisions go to a qualified professional.

families.name: Education and training
families.purpose: Designing courses, lessons, assessments and study support.
families.flow: Confirm learners and outcomes, design the material, align assessment to outcomes, and note what needs a real trial with learners.

families.name: Public sector and nonprofit
families.purpose: Grant, program, policy and community materials for public-benefit organizations.
families.flow: Confirm the mission and audience, draft from supplied facts, check claims and funder requirements the user provides, and list open items.

families.name: Personal and career
families.purpose: Help individuals with applications, interviews, career thinking and personal projects.
families.flow: Learn the person's goal and real experience, draft or plan from it, and keep every claim true to what they supplied.

families.name: Orchestration and meta
families.purpose: Routing work to the right specialists, breaking down plans, packaging handoffs and reviewing across families. The Coordinator itself lives in the pack folder.
families.flow: Route the task, decompose it, run the chosen specialists in sequence as perspectives, package each handoff, and review the combined result.
